property_summary: After two consecutive newGrantProposal calls, the grant stored at proposalCount-1 must be the first (recipient1, amount1) and the grant at proposalCount must be the second (recipient2, amount2); the mutant increments by 2, leaving an empty grant at proposalCount-1 that mismatches (recipient1, amount1).
change_summary: Replace 'proposalCount += 1;' with 'proposalCount += 2;' so each proposal increments the counter by two.
